verdict.rationale: AWS provides multiple mechanisms for bulk operations across resources: the CLI can script and automate actions across many AWS services (aws-docs-1, aws-docs-42), CloudFormation/CDK let you provision, update, or delete entire stacks of many resources in one action (aws-docs-6, aws-docs-7, aws-docs-26), and Resource Groups let you organize and act on tagged collections of resources (aws-docs-36, aws-docs-49). An official MCP server (aws-docs-50) further enables AI agents to invoke these bulk-capable APIs programmatically. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of batch/bulk API endpoints (e.g., batch operations limits, parallel execution semantics) and hands-on evidence of an AI agent actually performing large-scale bulk operations via these tools.
